package settings

import (
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestParseContract(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("accepts object and preserves strings", func(t *testing.T) {
		raw := []byte(" \n\t{\"plain\":\"value\",\"quote\":\"\\\"\",\"slash\":\"\\\\\",\"line\":\"first\\nsecond\",\"unicode\":\"雪☃\",\"empty\":\"\",\"\":\"empty key\"}\r\n ")
		want := map[string]string{
			"plain": "value",
			"quote": "\"",
			"slash": "\\",
			"line": "first\nsecond",
			"unicode": "雪☃",
			"empty": "",
			"": "empty key",
		}

		got, err := Parse(raw)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Parse() error = %v", err)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("Parse() = %#v, want %#v", got, want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("empty object returns non-nil map", func(t *testing.T) {
		got, err := Parse([]byte("{}"))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Parse() error = %v", err)
		}
		if got == nil {
			t.Fatal("Parse() returned a nil map")
		}
		if len(got) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("Parse() returned %d entries, want 0", len(got))
		}
	})

	t.Run("rejects duplicate keys", func(t *testing.T) {
		inputs := [][]byte{
			[]byte(`{"same":"first","same":"second"}`),
			[]byte(`{"same":"first","\u0073ame":"second"}`),
		}
		for _, raw := range inputs {
			if _, err := Parse(raw); err == nil {
				t.Errorf("Parse(%q) succeeded, want duplicate-key error", raw)
			}
		}
	})

	t.Run("rejects invalid inputs", func(t *testing.T) {
		cases := map[string][]byte{
			"empty input":       nil,
			"array":             []byte(`[]`),
			"null":              []byte(`null`),
			"nested object":     []byte(`{"key":{"nested":"value"}}`),
			"number value":      []byte(`{"key":1}`),
			"boolean value":     []byte(`{"key":true}`),
			"null value":        []byte(`{"key":null}`),
			"array value":       []byte(`{"key":["value"]}`),
			"malformed":         []byte(`{"key":"value"`),
			"trailing object":   []byte(`{"key":"value"} {}`),
			"trailing nonspace": []byte(`{"key":"value"}x`),
		}
		for name, raw := range cases {
			t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
				if _, err := Parse(raw); err == nil {
					t.Fatalf("Parse(%q) succeeded, want error", raw)
				}
			})
		}
	})
}
